description: Class inheritance and class references (M6): a bits-ui-like toggle group whose state is a base class with single and multiple subclasses chosen by a prop through a static factory; the instance is held as a union of the subclasses and as the base class; overridden methods dispatch by class (isPressed read by an inherited $derived field and an inherited getter, select through the base's toggle, clear through the base type), an overriding getter calls super's, a discriminant (kind) and instanceof narrow the union; $state and #private $state fields in the base and the subclasses (Svelte). React and Vue hold immutable selections in state: an abstract base class with abstract methods, subclasses with parameter properties and super(…) arguments, methods returning a union of the subclasses
